cborVectors.description: Every shortest-form argument width in one array: 23 (immediate), 24 (u8), 256 (u16), 65536 (u32), 2^32 (u64) — the RFC 8949 appendix-A ladder.
cborVectors.name: unsigned-argument-widths

cborVectors.description: Negative integers (−1, −100) and the three profile simple values.
cborVectors.name: negative-and-simple

cborVectors.description: RFC 8949 appendix-A byte and text strings: h'01020304' and "IETF".
cborVectors.name: bytes-and-text

cborVectors.description: Integer keys before text keys, bytewise over the encodings — the §4.2.1 deterministic order.
cborVectors.name: map-key-order

cborVectors.description: Argument 23 in the one-byte form — well-formed CBOR, not the shortest form, rejected.
cborVectors.name: non-shortest-u8

cborVectors.description: The indefinite-length marker is outside the profile.
cborVectors.name: indefinite-array

cborVectors.description: Major type 6 (a tag) is outside the profile.
cborVectors.name: tag

cborVectors.description: Float16 0.0 — no floats in the profile.
cborVectors.name: float

cborVectors.description: One item then garbage — the buffer is exactly one item.
cborVectors.name: trailing-bytes

cborVectors.description: A text string whose bytes are not UTF-8.
cborVectors.name: invalid-utf8

cborVectors.description: Eight nested arrays put the innermost item at the depth cap.
cborVectors.name: nesting-too-deep

intersectVectors.description: A full-house host against a modest client: min minor, HEVC only, 4:2:0 only, clipboard only, AND'd booleans, min ceiling.
intersectVectors.name: nominal-asymmetric

intersectVectors.description: A set against itself — the idempotence law as bytes.
intersectVectors.name: identical-idempotent

intersectVectors.description: Disjoint feature lists intersect to empty — absence is "not supported", never an error.
intersectVectors.name: disjoint-features

intersectVectors.description: Foreign keys survive intersection only on byte-equal agreement: key 100 (equal values) survives, key 101 (differing values) drops.
intersectVectors.name: unknown-entries-byte-equal-rule

messageVectors.description: 0x0F carrying every v1 key at a non-default value.
messageVectors.name: declaration-full-house

messageVectors.description: 0x11 proposing maxDatagramBytes 1500 — the DPLPMTUD raise, v1's one renegotiable key.
messageVectors.name: update-geometry-raise

messageVectors.description: 0x12 status 0x01, echoing the raise proposal verbatim.
messageVectors.name: ack-accepted

messageVectors.description: The type byte alone — a declaration has a body.
messageVectors.name: declaration-truncated

messageVectors.description: An IDR-request type byte fed to the declaration decoder.
messageVectors.name: declaration-bad-type

messageVectors.description: A CBOR array where the capability map belongs.
messageVectors.name: declaration-body-not-a-map

messageVectors.description: 1025 bytes — past the 1024 B capability-message ceiling, the anti-streaming stop, refused before any CBOR work.
messageVectors.name: declaration-over-budget

messageVectors.description: An empty proposal map — a no-op update is a bug, not a message.
messageVectors.name: update-empty-map

messageVectors.description: A proposal whose CBOR argument (23 in the u8 form) is not shortest-form — deterministic encoding is enforced end to end.
messageVectors.name: update-non-canonical-body

messageVectors.description: Status 0x00 — the loud zero-fill bug, never a value.
messageVectors.name: ack-zero-status

messageVectors.description: The type byte alone — an ack has a status and a body.
messageVectors.name: ack-truncated

setVectors.description: Capabilities.wireDefault — the hand-computed anchor (CapabilitiesTests): minor 0, HEVC, 4:2:0, idle-silence, no features, 1152 B ceiling.
setVectors.name: wire-default

setVectors.description: Every v1 key at a non-default value, including a foreign codec id (2) carried in the list.
setVectors.name: full-house

setVectors.description: wireDefault plus foreign key 100 → "x": the unknown-key-ignored rule — decodes, typed fields unaffected, re-encodes byte-exact.
setVectors.name: unknown-key-preserved

setVectors.description: Only the three required keys — the optional five default to unsupported / the 1152 B floor. Decode-only: a v1 re-encode emits all eight keys explicitly, so this legal-but-lean form is not byte-stable.
setVectors.name: required-keys-only

setVectors.description: wireMinor and chromaModes only — videoCodecs is required.
setVectors.name: missing-video-codecs

setVectors.description: wireMinor as a text string — registered keys carry their registered types.
setVectors.name: wrong-type-minor

setVectors.description: chromaModes [2, 1] — id lists are strictly ascending.
setVectors.name: descending-id-list

setVectors.description: maxDatagramBytes 1151 — below the 1152 B protocol floor.
setVectors.name: ceiling-below-floor

setVectors.description: A top-level array — a declaration body is a map.
setVectors.name: not-a-map
